name.full: objekts Production Desk — AI-native Visual Production Preflight

description.short: AI-native AI/VFX, CGI, motion and animation production preflight by objekts.
description.full: objekts Production Desk is an agent-native AI visual-production preflight system built by objekts. It works across generative video, AI/VFX, CGI/3D, motion, animation, compositing and commercial production planning. Physical live-action shoots are outside objekts scope and must not be budgeted as objekts production. Conventional shoot language is translated into AI/VFX/CGI/motion/compositing requirements unless source footage already exists.

agentConnectors.description: AI-native production preflight and routing for generative video, AI/VFX, CGI, motion, animation and compositing by objekts. Physical live-action production is outside scope.
